fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase ranked first in the 2026 Financial Quantum Index, with HSBC and Wells Fargo tied for second, and Mastercard placing third (up from 11th in 2025).
fields.summary_ko.1: The index evaluates quantum technology talent, R&D, and deployment cases across 64 financial institutions; expanded from 28 institutions in 2025 to 2026, with Mizuho achieving the highest new entrant ranking at 5th.
fields.summary_ko.2: JPMorgan Chase ranks first across research papers, patents, and use cases; Wells Fargo leads in research and patents, while HSBC excels in quantum talent and deployment capabilities.
